name: Explosions in the Sky

whyMatters.en: Austin instrumental quartet formed in 1999. The Earth Is Not a Cold Dead Place (2003, Temporary Residence) fixed delay-heavy interlocking guitars and soft-to-loud arcs; Your Hand in Mine became a common film and TV cue.
whyMatters.zh: 奥斯汀器乐四重奏，1999 年成立。《The Earth Is Not a Cold Dead Place》（2003，Temporary Residence）定型大量延时交织吉他与弱到强弧线；《Your Hand in Mine》常被影视采用。

shortBio.en: Austin instrumental post-rock, 1999–. Your Hand in Mine is the best-known crescendo cue.
shortBio.zh: 奥斯汀器乐 post-rock，1999 年至今。《Your Hand in Mine》是最知名的 crescendo 曲目。

body.en:
Explosions in the Sky formed in Austin in 1999. The Earth Is Not a Cold Dead Place (2003, Temporary Residence) set the studio sound: three guitars in delay, soft-to-loud arcs, no vocals. Song titles carry the narrative; arrangement dynamics carry the melody.

Your Hand in Mine (2003) is the usual entry track and a frequent Friday Night Lights sync. Later albums such as All of a Sudden I Miss Everyone and Take Care, Take Care, Take Care keep longer runtimes and larger tour scale.
body.zh:
Explosions in the Sky 于 1999 年在奥斯汀成立。《The Earth Is Not a Cold Dead Place》（2003，Temporary Residence）定下录音室声音：三把延时吉他、弱到强弧线、无人声。曲名提示叙事，编曲动态承担旋律。

《Your Hand in Mine》（2003）是常见入口曲，也常出现在《Friday Night Lights》中。后期专辑如《All of a Sudden I Miss Everyone》与《Take Care, Take Care, Take Care》继续加长曲长并扩大巡演规模。

note.en: Interlocking delay guitars and a slow build; frequent Friday Night Lights sync.
note.zh: 交织延时吉他与慢起渐强；常出现在《Friday Night Lights》。

body.en:
The band’s reference album is The Earth Is Not a Cold Dead Place (2003): five tracks, all instrumental, Temporary Residence.

Three guitars interlock in delay; drums stay relatively dry. Soft-to-loud arcs replace verse-chorus hooks.

Your Hand in Mine became a common US TV and film cue, especially via Friday Night Lights.
body.zh:
参照专辑是《The Earth Is Not a Cold Dead Place》（2003）：五曲、全器乐、Temporary Residence。

三吉他在延时里交织；鼓相对干。弱到强弧线替代主副歌钩子。

《Your Hand in Mine》成为常见美国影视配乐，尤其经《Friday Night Lights》。

body.en:
Since 1999 the lineup has been Rayani, Smith, Hrasky, and James—three guitarists, with James also covering bass live.

There is no vocalist on any album; titles supply narrative hints.

Early Texas DIY shows built the interlocking delay method before the Earth studio sessions.
body.zh:
1999 年起阵容为 Rayani、Smith、Hrasky、James——三吉他，James 现场兼贝斯。

全目录无人声；曲名提供叙事提示。

早期德州 DIY 现场先形成交织延时写法，再进入 Earth 录音室。

title.en: Instrumental rock in film and TV

body.en:
Alongside Mogwai and Godspeed You! Black Emperor, the band made wordless crescendo rock a regular option for US sync licensing.

Sonic Youth’s tunings and textural guitar are a named influence.

Your Hand in Mine and First Breath After Coma remain common entry tracks for listeners new to post-rock.
body.zh:
与 Mogwai、Godspeed You! Black Emperor 并列，乐队使无人声 crescendo 摇滚成为美国同步授权的常见选项。

Sonic Youth 的定弦与质感吉他是点名影响。

《Your Hand in Mine》与《First Breath After Coma》仍是 post-rock 新听者的常见入口。
